profile.headline: Experienced Software Engineer in Web Services
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with background in game development and ecommerce industries.  

Experienced in maintaining and developing full software life cycles including design, customer requirements and input, programming, testing, implementation, documentation, and support.   

Collaborate with other teams to adopt best practices for ensuring the solution design helps meet the operational, integration, cost, quality and performance goals of the customer.

Provide high levels of customer support and feedback in shaping the design and development 

Experience Developing with:​ JavaScript, Node, Microservices, AWS, Linux, ReST, HAL, swagger, C#, 
Visual Studio Code, Chrome plugins, Elastic Beanstalk, Docker, lambda, .net, terraform, mongodb, JIRA, Confluence, CMake, gcc, Java, C++, Python, SQL, Chrome, Xcode, Code Blocks.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Event Driven CQRS using C# to provide customer value.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Develop critical underlying services of Vistaprint's first Promotional Products and Apparel website: Promo Spot. 

Worked in small teams to design, operate and improve C# ReSTful HTTP APIs for customer fulfillment. 

Migrated microservice development from C# to JavaScript node. 

Developed scalable APIs allowing manufacturers to more seamlessly connect to the Mass Customization Platform (MCP) averaging 4 orders per second daily.

Provided customer service and support for problem management and MCP user onboarding.

Piloted and encouraged adoption of HAL standards in platform APIs. 

Managed Continuous Deployment system of services in AWS. 

Facilitated rapid customer onboarding through both creating and maintaining services documentation for internal/external customers including best practices guidelines for on-boarding and use of MCP. 

Facilitated rapid customer on boarding through both interpersonal interaction and relevant, up to date documentation

Developed internal developer and customer tools via chrome plugins. This resulted in increased quality of life and faster prototyping for internal developers as well as easier understanding of platform services and faster platform adoption by customers.

positions.title: Engineer
positions.description: Developed XAML UX for Microsoft Game Studio Windows 8/WinRT titles Adera and Disney Fairies Hidden Treasures, developed tools to support UX content, scripted levels in both games and assisted in development and maintenance of Ubiquity engine.

positions.title: Jr. Game Engineer
positions.description: Worked as a UX engineer on Adera for Windows 8 using XAML and WinRT API's.

positions.title: Student Recruiter
positions.description: Talk about my abroad experence and encourage students to spend a semester abroad at one of Champlain Colleges satellite campuses in Montreal or Dublin.

positions.title: Maintenance, Cashier
positions.description: Performed repairs and maintenance on machinery and other equipment. Promptly and courteously assist customers with check out and related sales transactions.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Modified firmware on embedded Linux based systems for integration with enterprise time Management service TC-1, resulted in providing customers more punch clock options.

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description: Served as one of three Game Programmers responsible for ActionScript coding an emergency protocol training game for Massachusetts General Hospital. Created a single pass XML parser resulting in reducing game load time. Cleaned up existing code to improve readability.

volunteerExperiences.description: Help to manage to maintain and coordinate the activities of the Polish American Citizens Club of South Boston. Including festivals, club events and providing educational resources.

Since 2018 I have been leading managing and organizing the orchestration of Polish Fest Boston. This involves coordinating with the city of Boston through several city agencies. This also includes booking entertainment reaching out and coordinating vendors and helping them all to set up and perform on the day of the festival. Polish Fest Boston is usually held around May 3rd and supports local non-profit organizations. 

https://bostonpolishfest.com/

projects.title: Disney Fairies Hidden Treasures
projects.description:
Tinker Bell is the newest resident of Pixie Hollow, and she’s doing her best to leave a lasting impression on the fairy world. After discovering her talent, Tink invents, builds and repairs new contraptions to make life easier for her fairy friends.   Join Fairy Mary, Bobble and Clank, Rosetta, Iridessa and all the other fairies as they teach Tink about Pixie Dust, sprinting thistles, the many uses of acorns, and the magical world of Pixie Hollow.

On my second project at Hitpoint Studios I again preformed many roles including level scripting in C#, but my main role on episode one was as UX engineer working on developing the HUB in XAML using WinRT API’s, in addition to again integration with Xbox Live connectivity. The interface scheme for Fairies was recognized by Microsoft Windows Developer Platform Evangelist Pete Brown as his top example of Windows 8 App interface.

projects.title: Adera
projects.description:
Jane Sinclaire has been on many dangerous adventures, but she’s never experienced anything like the mysterious city of Adera. Throughout her expedition, she’ll have to solve puzzles, collect artifacts, and explore the environments to reveal the mysteries of this new-found civilization.

This episodic story begins when Jane receives a desperate message from her long-missing grandfather. Using nothing but her wits and a strange stone orb to guide her, Jane sets out to find her grandfather before it’s too late.

On this project I preformed many roles, but my main one was as the UX engineer working on developing the HUB in XAML using WinRT API’s. In addition to integrating the interface with Xbox Live connectivity. The interface scheme established here has gone on to be a standard for windows 8 store games and was recognized by Microsoft Windows Developer Platform Evangelist Pete Brown as a leading example of Windows 8 interface design.
